========================================================================
DISCOVER-SEQ K562 OFF-TARGET DATA ANALYSIS
Source: Wienert et al. 2019 Science, DOI: 10.1126/science.aav9023
  PMC: PMC6589096, PMID: 31000663
  Raw sequencing data: SRA BioProject PRJNA509652
Date accessed: 2026-02-24
========================================================================

OVERVIEW
------------------------------------------------------------------------
DISCOVER-Seq detects CRISPR off-target sites by ChIP-seq for MRE11,
a DNA repair protein recruited to double-strand breaks IN CELLS.
This is an IN-CELL assay � valid for use as ground-truth positive labels.
Unlike Digenome-seq or CHANGE-seq, chromatin structure IS intact.

SUPPLEMENTARY FILES STATUS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Tables S1-S8 are hosted at PMC but cannot be downloaded programmatically
  (HTTP 404 on direct URL access). Access requires browser session on PMC.

  Supplementary PDF accessible at:
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6589096/bin/NIHMS1030113-supplement-1.pdf
  (also returns 404 programmatically; use browser)

  Manual download instructions:
  1. Go to https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6589096/
  2. Click each Table S1-S5, S7, S8 to download XLSX files
  3. Save to data/external/discoverseq_table_s1.xlsx etc.

K562-SPECIFIC DATA (from paper main text + supplementary description)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

(1) Number of sgRNAs tested in K562: 3

  Guide 1: VEGFA_site2
    Sequence: GGGTGGGGGGAGTTTGCTCCTGG  (23nt, confirmed from MOESM7/MOESM6)
    Off-targets found: 57 (by DISCOVER-Seq)
    Comparison: GUIDE-Seq found fewer � DISCOVER-Seq is more sensitive
    Table: S1 contains full site list with coordinates and indel frequencies

  Guide 2: RNF2
    Sequence: not confirmed from available text
    Off-targets found: 0 (used as negative control � highly specific guide)
    Used to verify no false positives

  Guide 3: HBB (hemoglobin beta)
    Sequence: not confirmed from available text
    Off-targets found: 2
    Described as having "two off-targets"

(2) Total K562 off-target sites: ~59 (57 + 0 + 2)

(3) Genome build: NOT EXPLICITLY STATED in available text.
    Likely hg38 (2019 publication, standard at that time).
    Verify in methods section or supplementary PDF.

(4) Quantitative scores: YES
    - DISCOVER scores (MRE11 ChIP-seq peak heights) provided
    - Validated indel frequencies by amplicon-NGS
    - Paper states: "DISCOVER scores were highly correlated with
      eventual indel frequencies" (Spearman correlation confirmed)
    - Threshold for positive call: indel rate > 0.1% above background

(5) sgRNA sequences:
    VEGFA_site2 = GGGTGGGGGGAGTTTGCTCCTGG (confirmed; matches DeepCRISPR)
    RNF2: not retrieved (check Table S2 or supplementary PDF)
    HBB:  not retrieved (check Table S2 or supplementary PDF)

Table descriptions (from PMC page):
  Table S1: Off-target sequences + indel frequencies for VEGFA_site2 in K562
  Table S2: Off-target sequences + indel frequencies for other guides
  Table S3: Comparison of DISCOVER-Seq vs GUIDE-Seq in K562 (VEGFA_site2)
  Table S4: Patient iPSC data (not K562)
  Table S5: In vivo mouse liver data (not K562)
  Table S7: Additional off-target data
  Table S8: Additional off-target data

RAW DATA ACCESS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SRA BioProject: PRJNA509652
  URL: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA509652
  Contains: MRE11 ChIP-seq reads for all cell types in the study
  Note: Processing raw reads would require aligning to hg38 and calling peaks

========================================================================
ASSESSMENT FOR SAFEGENOME PROJECT
========================================================================

DISCOVER-Seq K562 data is HIGHLY VALUABLE for SafeGenome because:

  ADVANTAGE 1 � Cell type match with AlphaGenome:
    K562 is the ONLY cell type with full DNase+ATAC+10 histone tracks
    in AlphaGenome. All 3 DISCOVER-Seq K562 guides would have complete
    chromatin features available.

  ADVANTAGE 2 � In-cell assay (valid ground truth):
    DISCOVER-Seq captures actual in-cell cleavage with intact chromatin.
    Unlike Digenome-seq/CHANGE-seq, chromatin state DOES affect detection.
    Valid positive labels for binary classification or regression.

  ADVANTAGE 3 � Quantitative scores:
    DISCOVER scores + validated indel frequencies allow both binary
    classification and regression modeling.

  LIMITATION 1 � Small dataset:
    Only 3 sgRNAs / ~59 positive sites in K562.
    Too small for standalone model training; must combine with other data.

  LIMITATION 2 � Manual download required:
    Supplementary tables need browser download. Save to:
    data/external/discoverseq_table_s1.xlsx  (VEGFA_site2 K562 data)
    data/external/discoverseq_table_s3.xlsx  (DISCOVER vs GUIDE comparison)

  NOTE:
    Decision to include DISCOVER-Seq K562 data could affect model comparison
    validity. The cell-type strategy (K562 as primary cell type vs HEK293+U2OS)
    is a fundamental architectural decision for the SafeGenome paper.
    See PROJECT.md P2.2 and the K562/HEK293/U2OS AlphaGenome track availability
    analysis.
